description: Chief Secretariat - Southern Province - Co-operative Societies Act. No. 05 of 1972 Completed the Liquidation
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the completion of liquidation for numerous Co-operative Societies under specific Co-operative Societies Acts. The content deals with business registrations, corporate dissolutions, and the formal closure of commercial entities (co-operative societies), which falls squarely under the definition of Commercial Gazettes (Type 6) for business and commercial matters, specifically corporate dissolutions.
